The app reads only SMS from the senders on your bank sender list, on this phone. It keeps the amounts, dates and merchants it finds, never the message text, except messages it cannot read, which wait for you in a review list with personal details hidden. Android will ask for the SMS permission next.
Reads every SMS already on this phone from the senders on your bank list, so your history is filled in. Messages from anyone else are never read. Safe to run again: nothing is added twice.

If Android says this setting is restricted: open App info, tap the ⋮ menu at the top, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again. Android does this for apps installed outside the Play Store.
